title: Search Outlook calendar events with AI by topic
h1: find the outlook appointment you can only partly remember
description: Find Outlook calendar events by topic with a bot. Learn the primary-calendar boundary and why personal accounts need a dated search window.
keyword: outlook search calendar events with ai
answer: **you remember the venue, not which saturday you booked it.** a bot searches your outlook primary calendar and returns matching appointments. work and school accounts use microsoft search. personal accounts need start and end dates when that search is unavailable. give a short topic or attendee clue and get the dates back in chat.
og_line: the right meeting from the clues you have.
what:
**one distinctive word can get you back to the appointment.** try a topic, venue or person. the bot returns matches from your primary calendar without changing them. shared and secondary calendars need a different action.

for personal accounts without microsoft search, give both ends of a date window. every word must match somewhere in the event’s title, preview, location or people. one or two words usually beat a long description.
uses: **recover a workshop date.** search by the workshop name you remember.
**find a venue.** give the place and dates for a personal-calendar scan.
**locate a customer meeting.** use an attendee clue before considering changes.
**compare similar appointments.** ask for candidates rather than a guessed winner.

routine.message:
each saturday at 09:10, search my personal outlook primary calendar for "pottery" in the next thirty days.

- finish scanning the entire date window
- list matching titles, dates and locations here
- say if the scan remains unfinished

never edit, decline or respond to an event.
routine.needs: outlook connected with read only; access to the personal account’s primary calendar
routine.output:
pottery appointments in the next thirty days
wheel workshop: saturday, 10:00, ashby kiln
pottery glaze consultation: following wednesday, 16:00
searched the whole thirty-day window on the primary calendar.

steps: **keep searches read only.** connect outlook for this bot.
**choose the account.** the appointment needs to be in its primary calendar.
**give the dates.** try a focused topic and confirm a familiar result.
**review the scan note.** then schedule it and edit the weekend time if needed.
watch: **personal scans need both dates.** work and school microsoft search ignores those scan-window settings.
**finish the personal-account date window.** an empty batch can have matching appointments after it.
**extra words can hide the meeting.** every term must match in a personal-account scan.
**use another route for shared and secondary calendars.** this action reaches the primary calendar only.

faq.q: does it work with a personal microsoft account?
faq.a: **yes, with dates when microsoft search is unavailable.** give start and end times and a short search phrase.

faq.q: why did an empty search find something later?
faq.a: **the first batch may have had no matches.** ask the bot to finish scanning the whole date window.

faq.q: can it search all my shared calendars?
faq.a: **this action reaches only your primary calendar.** use a separate approach for shared calendars.

steps: choose the account whose primary calendar holds the appointment
give a topic plus start and end dates
ask whether the whole search finished

mistakes.fix: start with one distinctive word. personal scans require every word to match.
finish the date window before drawing that conclusion.

tip.text: if the meeting lives on a shared calendar, say that first. this search will not reach it.
